scope: Versioned non-authorizing admission and orchestration successor for a future Q-011 Section 5.4 production-science campaign. It verifies candidate, execution, source-closure, and raw-product bytes; binds exact variant and seed launch overrides; validates every frozen float32 cadence slot, restart publication, and terminal stdout record; and emits a persisted exactly revalidatable complete diagnostic work graph. It does not mutate evidence, launch work, promote policy, authorize qualification, or close a manuscript claim.

attempt_admission_contract.candidate_rule: Read and hash-verify the clean-candidate manifest, executable, installed and reviewed environment profiles, exact production-science successor deck, required PIC source closure, and required reducer closure. Cross-bind commit, source bundle, executable path and hash, environment hash and control-plane version, and deck hash.
attempt_admission_contract.launch_rule: Read and hash-verify the selected pressure receipt, attempt contract, and reconciled registered-execution receipt. Require exact attempt ID, variant, seed, pressure, model overrides, seed overrides, launch argv, raw root, artifact root, candidate hashes, COMPLETED state, and planner-retention cross-links.
attempt_admission_contract.raw_byte_rule: Read every declared raw product through one no-follow file descriptor, require a stable regular-file identity, and verify SHA-256 and byte count before admission.
attempt_admission_contract.slot_rule: Require one exact common cycle and observed committed time per slot and enforce the frozen IEEE-754 binary32 nominal-slot assignment for every interior slot, exact t=0 and t=1200 endpoints, and the t=500 lateness cap.
attempt_admission_contract.restart_rule: Validate restart payload parameter headers and cycles, every payload completion marker, the exact manifest-to-payload membership and FNV-1a digests, and the manifest completion marker.
attempt_admission_contract.terminal_rule: Require one stdout artifact proving unique time-limit termination with terminal time, tlim, and cycle equal to the terminal snapshot.

particle_current_terminology.mhd_j2_interpretation: MHD current magnitude squared, not particle current

campaign_phase_contract.expansion_phases: Cumulative phases add exactly one complete paired triad at a time through phase_8_paired_triads.
campaign_phase_contract.expansion_decision: Each expansion requires an exact resource-telemetry decision record, the immediately preceding cumulative phase, the fixed allowed telemetry field list, and qualifying_output_inspected=false.
campaign_phase_contract.forbidden_expansion_basis: Physical or qualifying-output values may not influence expansion.

complete_work_graph.morphology_status: Energy-weighted CR distribution, refinement overlay, and publication-bound profile hooks emitted.
